page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top and a catchword at the lower right. Poem titles and verses run in the centre of the page.

main_text.head: IN I. AVRATVM.
main_text.p: TE vocat Auratum, te censet fama poetam, Téque aurata putat carmina multa dare. Verius Æratum, & vatem, mihi crede, potentem Diceret æratos scribere versiculos.
main_text.head: IN MANVM PASCHASII.
main_text.p: Cur tibi, Paschasi, quas pictor amicus ademit Causidicum certat reddere turba manus? Libera quæ miros dedit indignatio versus, Indolis adiutrix saepius egregiæ? Non studij pictor tanti, non causa tabellæ est, Non ulli nocet hæc nominis umbra tui. Sed tua quod meritum circumfert nomen imago Extimulat vatis pectora Causidici. Nam metuit ne si redeat lex Cincia, posthac Cogatur sterili lingua tacere foro.
main_text.head: D. FRANCISCO HASTIN-guæ Domino, in Angliam revertenti.
main_text.p: NE tibi sufficiant Maiorum illustria quæ te, Quæ genus omne tuum stemmata nobilitat: Sed splendens propriis decus hoc virtutibus auge: Sic poteris propria nobilitate frui.

page.notes: Printed heading "D.FRANCISCO HASTIN-guæ Domino, in Angliam reuertenti." is set in a centred block; the hyphenated word is kept as printed. The initial letters T and N are large woodcut-style initials, joined to their words. Long s is normalised to s throughout. Accents on "Téque" are as printed. The "IN" at lower right is a catchword.
